Defines the static configuration of a production step, including fields such as code, description, expected duration, and optional BOM references. It does not record execution data like timestamps or BOM components. When a new run begins, this reference data is copied into CurrentProductionSetupOutputStep.

props.label: Description
props.description: Provides detailed definition of the actions taken within the step.

props.label: Status
props.description: Reference to the status model, indicates the status of the current step running,

props.label: Expected Duration
props.description: Estimated time required to complete the step.

props.label: Max
props.description: The maximum acceptable value for the step check values. Defines the upper boundary of tolerance for the measurement. Must be greater than or equal to target.

props.label: Min
props.description: The minimum acceptable value for the step check value. Defines the lower boundary of tolerance for the measurement. Must be less than or equal to target.

props.label: Target
props.description: The expected or ideal value for the step check value. Serves as the reference point for evaluating whether a measured value is within acceptable limits. Must fall between min and max values.
